# A stated cost on a split that states no value of its own.
#
# The transaction is in CAD, so its splits are valued in CAD whether the file
# says so or not: a USD split with no `value:` is valued at its own amount,
# 100.00 CAD for 100.00 USD, and the transaction has therefore priced it — at
# 1, which is nonsense for USD, but priced all the same.
#
# The `cost_basis_cost:` beside it is refused for the same reason a cost
# stated next to an explicit value is: the transaction says what the currency
# cost, and a second answer can only disagree with it. Reading which keys the
# file happened to type, rather than whether the transaction prices the split,
# let this one through — the KVP was written, and then ignored, leaving the
# book stating one cost and using another.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_update_strategy_respects_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-01-10 * "Buy 100 USD, stating a cost and no value"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		cost_basis_cost: "1.4 CAD/USD"
	Assets:Bank -100.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
